name: geekist-architecture-skills
description: Thirty-nine independently usable agent skills for project writing, product narrative, developer adoption, commercial research and consistent project meaning.

interface.shortDescription: Writing, product narrative and developer growth
interface.longDescription: Choose a focused skill for the work at hand: shape product positioning and story, write a compelling GitHub README, improve developer adoption, refine prose, or continue Geekist's project writing, architecture and research practices. Upstream skills are preserved with attribution and can be installed individually. There is no required sequence.
defaultPrompt: Make this GitHub README more compelling while staying faithful to the product.
Position this product for the developers who will benefit from it.
Improve this writing while preserving its meaning and voice.
Research this company for credible collaboration or paid-work opportunities.
